# TruffleHog path exclusions — passed as `--exclude-paths` by
# .github/workflows/ci.yml (see the "Check for secrets" step there).
#
# Format: one regular expression per line, matched against the file path.
# Keep this list short and justified; every entry is a place where a real
# leaked secret could hide, so anything added here must be a file that no
# human writes by hand.
#
# Generated dependency lockfiles. These are written by npm/cargo, are reviewed
# as diffs by Dependabot, and are the dominant source of false positives in
# this repository:
#
#   - evm/package-lock.json tripped the Box detector. Its reported location
#     (line 719) is the literal string `"license": "MIT",`; the only "box"
#     substrings in the file are the package names @nomicfoundation/hardhat-toolbox,
#     boxen and cli-boxes, and the file contains no JWT, no credential-bearing
#     URL and no 32-character lowercase-alnum token anywhere in its 9388 lines.
#
# Trivy still scans these files for known-vulnerable dependencies in the same
# job, so excluding them from secret scanning does not drop them from review.
package-lock\.json$
(^|/)yarn\.lock$
(^|/)pnpm-lock\.yaml$
(^|/)Cargo\.lock$
